usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġometra kejjel l-angoli kollha tal-forma ġeometrika.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ewlidi kien ġometra rinomat li kiteb bosta kotba.
usage_examples.text_en: Euclid was a renowned geometer who wrote many books.

definitions.text_mt: Fergħa tal-matematika li tistudja l-punti, il-linji, il-forom u l-ispazji.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġometrija hija waħda mill-fergħat fundamentali tal-matematika.
usage_examples.text_en: Geometry is one of the fundamental branches of mathematics.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tgħallimna l-ġometrija Ewklidja fl-iskola sekondarja.
usage_examples.text_en: We learned Euclidean geometry in secondary school.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-problema ġiet solvuta ġometrikament.
usage_examples.text_en: The problem was solved geometrically.

usage_examples.text_mt: Din il-forma tista' tiġi deskritta ġometrikament.
usage_examples.text_en: This shape can be described geometrically.

usage_examples.text_mt: Id-disinn kellu forom ġometriċi differenti.
usage_examples.text_en: The design had different geometric shapes.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-problema ġometrika kienet diffiċli ħafna għall-istudenti.
usage_examples.text_en: The geometric problem was very difficult for the students.

definitions.text_en: Jordan (a country in West Asia in the Middle East, officially the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan)
definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fil-Lvant Nofsani, fil-Punent tal-Asja. Isem uffiċjali: Renju Ħaxemita tal-Ġordan.

definitions.text_mt: Xmara fil-Lvant Nofsani li tgħaddi fil-Baħar il-Mejjet, u tgħaddi mill-Iżrael, mill-Għolja tal-Golan, mix-Xatt tal-Punent u mill-Ġordan.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Ġordan huwa pajjiż fil-Lvant Nofsani mal-fruntiera tal-Palestina.
usage_examples.text_en: Jordan is a country in the Middle East on the border with Palestine.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ix-xmara Ġordan tgħaddi fil-Baħar il-Mejjet.

usage_examples.text_en: He was a man of gigantic build, almost a giant from a legend.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġorfa kienu jgħixu fil-muntanji skond l-istejjer antiki.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Ġorġjan huwa l-lingwa uffiċjali tal-Ġeorġja.
